description: This file defines the 'PerformancePluginConfiguration' class which implements plugin configuration for the Performance module in the OrangeHRM system. It registers various services related to performance tracking, KPIs, reviews, and logs into a dependency injection container within the initialization method.

classes.name: PerformancePluginConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the performance-related services during plugin initialization, implementing plugin configuration interface.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Registers performance-related services into the dependency injection container during plugin startup.
